name: Figure 03
summary: Figure's third-generation humanoid with tactile five-finger hands, used by Figure itself and a few US customers; there is no way to buy one.

germany.statusNote: No sale or price for anyone: Figure allocates robots from its BotQ plant to internal R&D, data collection, housework development and commercial use-case development. Named customers are in the US (BMW Spartanburg; Catalyst Brands, Reno). The website has no order form or price.

specs.label: Payload
specs.conditions: not stated whether per arm or both arms

specs.label: Charging
specs.value: wireless inductive charging through coils in the feet at 2 kW

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: head cameras plus a palm camera in each hand; fingertip tactile sensors detect about 3 g

notes: Figure markets it first for household tasks; commercial use is logistics and car-plant sequencing in the US.
Covered in washable soft textiles; battery certified to UN38.3.

images.alt: Four Figure 03 humanoids in grey textile covers standing in a BMW assembly hall

evidence.task: Sequence car parts into carts and pull a loaded cart along the line
evidence.note: Figure calls it the first demonstration of Figure 03 in a logistics workflow at the plant.

evidence.task: Routine, repetitive supply-chain tasks in a retail distribution center
evidence.where: Catalyst Brands distribution center, Reno, USA
evidence.note: Agreement announced 26 May 2026 to deploy Figure humanoids, starting at the Reno center; robot generation and start of work not stated.

sources.title: Figure Signs Agreement with Catalyst Brands (26 May 2026)

openQuestions: Is the 20 kg payload per arm or for both arms?
